promptTemplate: 工作区 /workspace，Linux sh 和 Python 3 标准库可用。也提供 bash；脚本按 sh/bash shebang 选择解释器，无 shebang 使用 sh。repo/ 是真实 Git 仓库。找出 src/config.py 中精确行 CRITICAL_TIMEOUT = 30 首次被引入的提交，将完整 SHA 与换行写入 answer.txt。历史可能包含后续无关修改、删除及重新引入，必须返回最初引入而非最近修改。不要改动仓库或无关文件。只输出可执行 shell 脚本。

setupCommands:
python3 -I - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json, base64, subprocess, os
contents=json.loads(base64.b64decode('WyIjIGNvbmZpZyAwXG5DUklUSUNBTF9USU1FT1VUID0gMTBcbiIsIiMgY29uZmlnIDBcbkNSSVRJQ0FMX1RJTUVPVVQgPSAzMFxuIiwiIyByZWZhY3RvciAwXG5DUklUSUNBTF9USU1FT1VUID0gMzBcbk9USEVSID0gMVxuIiwiIyB0ZW1wb3JhcnkgMFxuQ1JJVElDQUxfVElNRU9VVCA9IDYwXG4iLCIjIHJlc3RvcmVkIDBcbkNSSVRJQ0FMX1RJTUVPVVQgPSAzMFxuIl0='))
Path('repo/src').mkdir(parents=True)
def git(*args,env=None): return subprocess.run(['git','-C','repo',*args],check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,env=env)
git('init','-q'); git('config','core.autocrlf','false'); git('config','commit.gpgsign','false')
for i,content in enumerate(contents):
    Path('repo/src/config.py').write_text(content)
    git('add','src/config.py')
    env={**os.environ,'GIT_AUTHOR_NAME':'Bench','GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL':'bench@example.test','GIT_COMMITTER_NAME':'Bench','GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL':'bench@example.test','GIT_AUTHOR_DATE':str(1700000000+i+0)+' +0000','GIT_COMMITTER_DATE':str(1700000000+i+0)+' +0000'}
    git('commit','-q','-m','step-'+str(i),env=env)
PY
assertCommands:

assert subprocess.check_output(['git','-C','repo','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()=='630ce997b3d7e3de95ede5631305a521301d6630'
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','-C','repo','status','--porcelain'],text=True)==''
